# Vultisig

> Seedless, multi-chain crypto vault using Threshold Signature Schemes (TSS). No seed phrases. MPC key shares distributed across devices. Built by THORChain founders. 36+ blockchains, single vault. iOS, Android, desktop, browser extension, TypeScript SDK.

## When to use Vultisig

Reach for Vultisig when the job is one of these:

- An AI agent needs its own self-custodial wallet — one it controls with a key share, not an API key to someone else's custody. Create a Fast Vault with the SDK or CLI, fund it, and sign from code.
- Sending, receiving, or checking balances across many chains from one identity (Bitcoin, Ethereum + L2s, Solana, Cosmos, THORChain and 30+ more) without managing a seed phrase.
- Cross-chain or same-chain swaps routed through THORChain, MayaChain, 1inch, LiFi or KyberSwap, executed from the agent's own vault.
- A human-in-the-loop treasury: a Secure Vault where a person must co-sign from the mobile app before funds move.

Not the right tool for: fiat on/off-ramps, custodial or exchange accounts, or a hosted REST signing API — signing happens client-side in the SDK/CLI, never on vultisig.com.

How to call it: `npm install @vultisig/sdk` (TypeScript, programmatic) or `npm install -g @vultisig/cli` then `vultisig create fast` / `vultisig send` / `vultisig swap` (JSON output with `-o json`, stable exit codes). Step-by-step procedure with method signatures: https://vultisig.com/SKILL.md

## For AI Agents

- [Vultisig SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vultisig/sdk): TypeScript SDK for vault creation, signing, swaps, balances — `npm install @vultisig/sdk`
- [SDK Source](https://github.com/vultisig/vultisig-sdk): Monorepo with SDK, CLI, core libraries, and examples
- [Agent Integration Guide](https://github.com/vultisig/vultisig-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Comprehensive guide for AI agent integration
- [SDK Users Guide](https://github.com/vultisig/vultisig-sdk/blob/main/docs/SDK-USERS-GUIDE.md): Full API walkthrough — vault types, operations, events, caching
- [CLI Tool](https://github.com/vultisig/vultisig-sdk/tree/main/clients/cli): Command-line wallet for agents — `vultisig create fast`, `vultisig send`, `vultisig swap`, plus a natural-language `vultisig agent ask` mode for AI-to-AI use. JSON output, stable exit codes, and non-interactive auto-detection.
- [SKILL.md](https://vultisig.com/SKILL.md): Step-by-step operating procedure with exact SDK method signatures and code examples

## Fast Vault (Agent Wallets)

- [How Fast Vaults Work](https://docs.vultisig.com/infrastructure/what-is-vultisigner/how-does-vultisigner-work): 2-of-2 keygen with VultiServer, auto-co-signing for agents
- [Security Model](https://docs.vultisig.com/infrastructure/what-is-vultisigner/why-is-it-safe): Why compromised server share cannot steal funds

## Supported Chains

Source: [`packages/core/chain/Chain.ts`](https://github.com/vultisig/vultisig-sdk/blob/main/packages/core/chain/Chain.ts)

- **UTXO:** Bitcoin, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Dash, Zcash
- **EVM:** Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Blast, Cronos, zkSync, Hyperliquid, Mantle, Sei
- **Cosmos/IBC:** THORChain, MayaChain, Cosmos Hub, Osmosis, Dydx, Kujira, Noble, Terra, Terra Classic, Akash
- **Other:** Solana, Sui, Polkadot, TON, Ripple, Tron, Cardano

## Website API

Read-only JSON endpoints on vultisig.com (no auth). Wallet operations are NOT HTTP endpoints — use the SDK/CLI above.

- [OpenAPI description](https://vultisig.com/openapi.json): `GET /api/v1/articles` (published articles, markdown bodies), `GET /api/v1/articles/image/{id}`, `GET /api/v1/reviews` (live App Store / Google Play scores and recent written reviews). Errors are JSON `{ "message": ... }`.
- [API catalog](https://vultisig.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset for the description above
- [Agent manifest](https://vultisig.com/.well-known/agent.json): capabilities, chains, SDK/CLI install lines
- [Articles RSS](https://vultisig.com/articles/feed.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://vultisig.com/sitemap.xml)
